summary: Very short kerb by a junction; cars park here but flats are 17 m away.
reasons: Only 10 m, right beside a junction

best_section.where: Beatrice Street west kerb, just north of the side street, beside the old shop building

drivers.seclusion: Shop building 3 m away (non-residential); nearest dwelling is the Inglenook flats 17 m away at the start, more houses 20 m and beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Public kerb with cars parked in line just south of it; a 7.5 m van barely fits in 10 m beside the junction mouth.
drivers.traffic: Quiet junction with a side street; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb in both images, though a 2P Mon-Fri 9am-4pm limit applies.

flags: Corner position, tight for a van
sun_shade: Mostly open; the building to the west shades the kerb in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether a shop or flats occupy the building
